File ownership/mode mismatch on an IPA-managed security-critical file
ipa-healthcheck's ipahealthcheck.ipa.files.TomcatFileCheck directly reports an incorrect owner, group,
or mode on a security-critical file: Permissions of /var/lib/pki/pki-tomcat/conf/ca/CS.cfg are too
permissive: 0664 and should be 0660. This finding is itself direct evidence of a plain Unix
ownership/permissions problem, independent of whether SELinux is also involved.
